title: Daily digest: Andhra’s coalition govt mocking electora | Revanth Reddy’s water allocation to Dind | T.N. Minister Vanni Arasu reviews monsoo | FPIs withdraw ₹48,056 cr from equities i
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: Munsif Daily / Telangana Today / The Hindu
bullets_en: Andhra’s coalition govt mocking electoral process, says YSRCP.
Revanth Reddy’s water allocation to Dindi sparks row between Nalgonda, Palamuru leaders.
T.N. Minister Vanni Arasu reviews monsoon preparedness in Villupuram.
FPIs withdraw ₹48,056 cr from equities in October so far amid elevated crude oil prices.
bullets_ur: Andhra ki coalition hukumat intikhabi amal ka mazaaq ura rahi hai, YSRCP ka kehna hai
Revanth Reddy ke Dindi ko pani allot karne par Nalgonda, Palamuru ke leadron mein tanaza phoot para
T.N. Wazir Vanni Arasu ne Villupuram mein monson ki taiyyariyon ka jaiza liya
FPIs ne October mein ab tak equities se 48,056 crore rupay bahar nikale, crude oil ke barhtay qeemat ke karan
